name: COD_CONTACT_INFO
description: The table COD_CONTACT_INFO contains information about coding records (records in the COD master file). A row in this table contains information about each individual contact for coding records. Coding records store information from Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) reviews. A single coding record is created for the hospital account, with each contact (or row) containing information from a separate CDI review of the account.

columns.name: CODING_RECORD_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the coding record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: CONTACT_SERIAL_NUM
columns.description: The contact serial number (CSN) of the contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUM
columns.description: The contact number of the contact.

columns.name: CNCT_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The contact type of the contact.

columns.name: CDI_USER_ID
columns.description: The user ID of the clinical documentation improvement (CDI) specialist who performed the CDI review.

columns.name: CDI_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: CDI_NEXT_REVIEW_DT
columns.description: The next review date for a clinical documentation improvement (CDI) review.

columns.name: CDI_PX_CODE_SET_C_NAME
columns.description: The procedure code set in a clinical documentation improvement (CDI) review.

columns.name: CDI_DX_CODE_SET_C_NAME
columns.description: The diagnosis code set in a clinical documentation improvement (CDI) review.

columns.name: CONTACT_STAT_C_NAME
columns.description: This item stores the current status of a contact on the coding record.

columns.name: CDI_REVIEW_LOC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time that a clinical documentation improvement (CDI) review took place, relative to the timezone of the location in which the review took place.

columns.name: LINKED_QUERY_ID
columns.description: This column is reserved for future development.

columns.name: SOURCE_CSN_ID
columns.description: This item contains the contact serial number from the source coding record associated with this coding contact. This item is set when a coding contact is merged from another coding record.

columns.name: ADMIT_DATETIME_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The admission date associated with the hospital account's primary encounter.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_DATETIME_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The discharge instant associated with the hospital account's primary encounter.

columns.name: ADMIT_CATEGORY_C_NAME
columns.description: The admission category for the patient.

columns.name: TRANSFER_FROM_C_NAME
columns.description: The transfer source of the patient.

columns.name: DISCH_DEST_C_NAME
columns.description: The discharge destination for the patient.

columns.name: HOSP_ADMSN_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The admission type for the patient.

columns.name: ADMIT_SOURCE_C_NAME
columns.description: The point of origin for the patient.

columns.name: DISCH_DISP_C_NAME
columns.description: The discharge disposition of the patient.

columns.name: MEANS_OF_ARRV_C_NAME
columns.description: The means of arrival for the patient.

columns.name: PRIMARY_HOSP_SERV_C_NAME
columns.description: The primary service for the patient.

columns.name: SECONDARY_HOSP_SERV_C_NAME
columns.description: The secondary service of the patient.

columns.name: ADMITTING_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: ATTENDING_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: REFFERING_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.
